profile.name: Asmita Rahman
profile.subtitle: AI/ML & Full-Stack Developer
profile.description: Highly motivated Computer Science & Engineering student at Daffodil International University with hands-on experience in AI/ML, deep learning, full-stack web development, and computer vision. Seeking a technology internship to apply expertise in building AI agents, deploying ML models with Docker, and developing scalable applications.

text: I am a 4th-year Computer Science & Engineering student at Daffodil International University with a passion for building intelligent systems and modern software applications.

My technical journey bridges deep learning, computer vision, and full-stack engineering. I build practical AI solutions such as real-time banknote detection using YOLOv11 and Docker, multi-tool medical AI agents using LangChain, and crowd flow analysis with heatmap tracking. On the web side, I design scalable, responsive architectures with TypeScript, React.js, FastAPI, and Node.js.

Beyond coding, I actively participate in leadership and academic communities as the Assistant General Secretary of the Computer Girls Computer Club, Associate Member of CPC Club, and Member of the Bangladesh Space Research Society, where I received the Best Executive Award.

experience.description: Leading club activities, coordinating hands-on coding workshops, organizing technical events, and mentoring female engineering students in computer science and software development.
Organized outreach programs, science seminars, and tech workshops. Honored with the Best Executive Award for dedication and operational excellence.
Developing deep learning models and computer vision pipelines (YOLOv11, Docker, FastAPI), building AI agents with LangChain, and creating responsive web applications.

projects.name: Bangladeshi Taka Note Detection
projects.description: Built a deep learning model using YOLOv11 for real-time banknote detection and classification, deployed as a REST API with Docker containerization for scalable production deployment. Covers an end-to-end ML pipeline from data annotation to containerized inference.

projects.name: Multi-Tool AI Agent for Medical Datasets
projects.description: Developed an intelligent AI agent for medical dataset interaction using multi-tool orchestration with LangChain. Features NLP-based reasoning and automated web retrieval for healthcare data querying and analysis.

projects.name: AURA
projects.description: Intelligent AI assistant with natural language understanding and reasoning capabilities. Built as a full-stack TypeScript application featuring a responsive conversational interface and dynamic workflow execution.

projects.name: SYNAPSE
projects.description: Collaborative platform enabling team-based workflows and real-time communication. An active open-source project designed for seamless developer teamwork and productivity.

projects.name: People Flow Detection
projects.description: Computer vision system for crowd analysis and movement pattern recognition. Utilizes object tracking algorithms paired with heatmap visualization to analyze human density and flow dynamics.

projects.name: Meal Sphere
projects.description: Full-stack meal management application built with TypeScript and modern web frameworks. Features structured meal planning, calorie and macro tracking, and nutritional analysis.

services.title: AI & Machine Learning
services.description: Custom deep learning architectures, YOLOv11 computer vision models, LangChain multi-tool AI agents, and NLP data querying systems.

services.title: Full-Stack Web Development
services.description: Fast, responsive web applications built with TypeScript, React.js, and modern CSS — engineered for performance and clean user experience.

services.title: Model Deployment & Docker
services.description: High-throughput REST APIs built with FastAPI, containerized with Docker, and structured for scalable, reliable production deployments.

services.title: Computer Vision & Analytics
services.description: Object detection, real-time tracking, spatial density heatmaps, and image classification tailored for real-world scenarios.

services.title: Collaborative Software
services.description: Open-source platforms, team productivity tools, and real-time interactive dashboards with modern developer tooling.

services.title: Technical Leadership & Mentoring
services.description: Organizing workshops, mentoring peers in programming and algorithms, and leading student initiatives in tech communities.
